title: Local CUDA regression on DGX Spark for PR #3412 mcg admission
pr_a_head_tested: ff439ed55 (updated from 5d6dc705c; buffer aliasing fix applied)

bug_caught_and_fixed.description: Buffer aliasing in admit.group(): both mul1_name and mcg_name shared one &buf, so the second bufPrint overwrote the first. On a mul1-only checkpoint, ck.has(mul1_name) read bytes that spelled 'p.mcg' not 'p.mul1', causing admission to fall through to the mcg-else branch and refuse the checkpoint.
bug_caught_and_fixed.introduced_in: stage6c-cuda-mcg @ 5d6dc705c (my Stage 7E hygiene commit; the writeBoth() dual-marker test surfaced it)
bug_caught_and_fixed.fix: Added a second mcg_buf: [240]u8 so each name has its own backing buffer.

failed_tests: EXL3 admission: invalid widths refuse before upload and dense admits only compiled variants
EXL3 admission: mixed supported widths and allocator failures stay host owned
EXL3 admission: a group carrying both mul1 and mcg markers is refused

available_checkpoints_inventory.method: hf_api scan of Qwen3.5 EXL3 variants from UnstableLlama, async0x42, isogen, etc.
